title: Friday Night Magic 2013: card flavor text

entities.name: Knights of the Reliquary
entities.description: An order of knights who once guarded a remote tower of dusty treasures.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A faction whose territories are places where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A figure who never tires of the music of devil-blades and dripping blood.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: A speaker who warns that something is dangerous to recognize and deadly not to.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: A faction said to come from the cold slow depths.

entities.name: Kroshkar
entities.description: A Gruul shaman who disdains the Simic.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: A faction to whom anything buried is treasure.

relations.note: Kroshkar holds that the Simic cannot understand a wild heart.
relations.quote: The Simic come from the cold slow depths. How could they understand the fire in a wild heart?
